notes.title: Patch #1 - New items, upgrades and fixes!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, we're releasing the first patch for Pizzeria which includes some QoL changes, new upgrades and various fixes. We're also removing the "First Pizza" drop and adding three new items to the drop pool. Expect new updates and items to be released in the coming days!

Remember to [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]join our Discord[/url] for updates, pizza suggestions and special giveaways!

Changelog:

[b]DROPS[/b]
[list]
[*] Added "Pizza Pedro", "Pizza Vinyl" and "Pizza Low Poly" to the drop pool
[*] Removed "The First Pizza"
[*] Changed the drop rate of the "Pizza" item
[/list]
[b]GAMEPLAY[/b]
[list]
[*] Added two upgrades
[*] Decreased beer event chance of happening
[/list]
[b]UI[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the way upgrades effects are displayed
[*] Changed upgrades colors
[/list]

notes.title: Pizzeria Release Day!
notes.notes:
We are excited to announce that our game is now available!

To celebrate the launch, [b]everyone[/b] will be able to drop an [b]exclusive limited item[/b]. Also, remember that when we reach 100 members, we'll be doing a giveaway for [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]Discord[/url] members and early birds.

New updates will be coming in the next few days that will add new exclusive items, in-game upgrades, features, and much more. So follow us, [url=https://discord.com/invite/WqE6X2RRuu]join our Discord[/url], and stay tuned.

[i]Have fun eating pizza![/i]
